rationale: Record a macOS plug-in editor input change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through its broad core/view selector. The plug-in view host now accepts the first mouse-down in a non-key host window, so a press on an embedded editor reaches the control instead of only activating the window. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, render backend, asset, codegen output, fixture or threshold changes, and nothing is painted differently. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
